summary: The mathematical content of this file is entirely independent of the solvable-radical predicate: it is the generic "least ideal transports across an ambient isomorphism" argument plus the generic quotient-iso packaging, both of which already exist in the repo in strictly less general (single-object) form and are here re-proved verbatim for a third special case. Generalize the underlying lemmas in HopfIdeal/Quotient/Basic.lean and derive the solvable (and unipotent/center) cases from them.
